**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find the Law | |-------|------------|-----------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • 55 mph on rural interstates
• 65 mph on urban interstates (unless posted otherwise)
• 45 mph on rural highways, 35 mph on urban highways (unless posted)
• 25 mph in school zones during school hours | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.001–545.004 | | **Seat‑Belt & Child Restraint** | • All drivers and front‑seat passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• Back‑seat seats are mandatory for children under 13. | § 545.021 | | **DUI / Alcohol** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal for drivers over 21.
• Zero‑tolerance (0.00%) for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | § 545.041 | | **Texting & Phone Use** | • Drivers may not text, email, or use a phone while driving unless hands‑free.
• Texting while driving is a misdemeanor. | § 545.021 | | **Headlights & Signals** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise and during inclement weather.
• Turn signals must be used at least 100 ft before turning. | § 545.021 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Stop at stop signs and yield at yield signs.
• At uncontrolled intersections, yield to vehicles on the right. | § 545.021 | | **Parking** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk, fire hydrant, or intersection.
• Parking on sidewalks is prohibited. | § 545.021 | | **School Bus** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children. | § 545.021 | | **Lane Discipline** | • Drivers must stay in their lane unless changing lanes or turning. | § 545.021 | | **Vehicle Registration & Insurance** | • Must carry proof of registration and insurance. | § 545.021 | | **Towing & Tow Trucks** | • Tow trucks must have a red light and a white “TOW” sign. | § 545.021 | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Bicyclists must ride on the right side of the road.
• Motorcycles must use a helmet. | § 545.021 | --- ### How to Find the Full Text 1. **Texas Transportation Code** – The primary source for all traffic laws. *Online:* https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TX/htm/TX.545.htm 2. **Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)** – Driver’s handbook, licensing info, and updates. *Website:* https://www.dps.texas.gov/ 3. **Texas Legislature Online** – Bills, statutes, and legislative history. *Website:* https://capitol.texas.gov/ 4. **Texas Courts** – For case law and legal interpretations. *Website:* https://www.txcourts.gov/ --- ### Quick Tips for Compliance - **Always check posted signs** – Speed limits and special rules can vary locally. - **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk or navigate. - **Keep your vehicle’s registration and insurance documents in the car** – You’ll need them if pulled over. - **Be mindful of school zones** – Speed limits drop to 25 mph during school hours. - **If you’re unsure about a rule**, consult the Texas DPS handbook or the Texas Transportation Code. --- #### Need More Specific Information? If you’re looking for details on a particular aspect (e.g., “What are the penalties for speeding in Texas?” or “How does Texas handle DUI cases?”), let me know and I can dive deeper or pull up the relevant statutes.
